Chapter 6761: Fire Emperor Elephant

Chapter 6761: Fire Emperor Elephant

“Why not?” Li Qiye asked with a smile.

“The birth of every life in Divine Firmament is a monumental event.” She said.

Only adult divine beasts gave birth to offspring. Every single one was celebrated. Thus, Qing Ji couldn’t have snuck one away.

“Recall things that have the highest and least probabilities of happening.” He smirked.

“Hmm...” She pondered and suddenly recalled something, causing her to stagger backward.

“What did you come up with?” He asked.

“Young Noble, I do not wish to speak without ample evidence.” She calmed down and said.

“Isn’t she a piece of evidence?” Li Qiye stared at the young girl: “It seems like you’re not ready to accept the truth.”

“Boom!” The girl released the final star breath and roared at the sky again.

The lord was fascinated by the change - the empty seabed was now full of shiny star water. The waves and winds issued pleasant metallic ringings.

She submerged underwater, alarming him.

“Sweetheart!” He wanted to pull her out.

“Leave her be, she needs to recover.” Xiaoyue stopped him.

He stopped and watched her under the water, sleeping in the fetal position. He heaved a sigh of relief afterward.

Meanwhile, more and more heavenly beasts gathered in all directions, ranging from weak to strong. All types could be seen.

“Hallowed iron tiger...” He murmured after seeing a tiger with a gleaming iron body. Its tail was lined with barbs like an iron chain.

This was a king-level beast. His mountain-mover beast paled in comparison despite being on the same level.

“Screech!” A nine-headed bird let out a piercing screech from above. Its wings caused devastating gales like countless sword energies, leaving scars on the ground along the way.

“Nine-headed sword bird.” This was another king-level bird.

“Splash!” A beast resembling a civet leapt out of the water, spreading its limbs wide. The thin membrane stretched between the four limbs, allowing it to glide through the sky. Streaks of lightning flickered on its fur.

“Lightning phantom civet.” The lord recognized this heavenly beast.

In just a short time, he saw many rare beasts of the king level. It took a long time before he found his mountain-mover beast, not to mention the taming process.

As they gathered, they roared as if greeting each other. Then, one after another, they submerged themselves in the water.

“What are they doing?” The lord couldn’t help but ask: “Is this the true meaning behind the ocean?”

The ocean was more than just a body of water. It encompassed countless beasts as well.

“Bam!” A colossal beast appeared, crushing mountains with each step and melting the ground into lava.

“Fire Emperor Elephant!” He shouted.

This was an emperor-level beast only found in Azure Plain in this world. He didn’t expect to see one today.

Meanwhile, Xiaoyue prepared a jade table for Li Qiye as well as tea. He sat down and took a sip.

“They’re all here.” He remarked.

“To show respect to the ancestor.” Xiaoyue said.

“So this bloodline is the ancestral one for the heavenly beasts.” He stared at the slumbering girl.

“It must be after Demon Beast Epoch.” She said.

“I don’t think so.” He shook his head.

“No matter how I calculate the timing, Qing Ji’s betrayal and death should be after this epoch.” She said.

“You’re talking about life, not the bloodline. The bloodline can include the gestation period.” He said.
